name: g46_roar_sitrus_entrant
purpose: Roar (forceSwitch, sound) by Gyarados on the foe in slot 1 (Kingambit) drags it out, and the reserve the draw picks, a Decidueye holding Sitrus Berry, comes in: the Update after the drag has two Sitrus holders of equal speed (the entrant and the foe's Decidueye in slot 2), a real tie. Step G46 fix: the entrant's speed is its cached raw Speed, not the speed of the Pokemon it replaced.
